Generates \u003ccode\u003econverted-map.js\u003c/code\u003e that you can use like\n\u003ccode\u003egentle.js\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003c/ul\u003e\n\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eAdding background music with Replicate (Optional)\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eFor Daily background music generation, create a \u003ca href=\"https://replicate.com/\" rel=\"nofollow\"\u003eReplicate\u003c/a\u003e account and\ncreate a token in your Profile's \u003ca href=\"https://replicate.com/account/api-tokens\" rel=\"nofollow\"\u003eAPI Token page\u003c/a\u003e.\n\u003ccode\u003enpx convex env set REPLICATE_API_TOKEN # token\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eThis only works if you can receive the webhook from Replicate. If it's running in the normal\nConvex cloud, it will work by default. If you're self-hosting, you'll need to configure it to hit\nyour app's url on \u003ccode\u003e/http\u003c/code\u003e. If you're using Docker Compose, it will be \u003ccode\u003ehttp://localhost:3211\u003c/code\u003e,\nbut you'll need to proxy the traffic to your local machine.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eNote\u003c/strong\u003e: The simulation will pause after 5 minutes if the window is idle. <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" href="https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/3489963/260520547-a4c91f17-23ed-47ec-8c4e-9f9a8505057d.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..fyNa4SRnrhw-2XRc0gwqO808wAtUML1rJ0goV8Oigjw"><img width="1454" alt="Screen Shot 2023-08-14 at 10 01 00 AM" src="https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/3489963/260520547-a4c91f17-23ed-47ec-8c4e-9f9a8505057d.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..fyNa4SRnrhw-2XRc0gwqO808wAtUML1rJ0goV8Oigjw" style="max-width: 100%;"></a>
<p dir="auto">AI Town is a virtual town where AI characters live, chat and socialize.</p>
<p dir="auto">This project is a deployable starter kit for easily building and customizing your own version of AI
town. Inspired by the research paper
<a href="https://arxiv.org/pdf/2304.03442.pdf" rel="nofollow"><em>Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior</em></a>.</p>
<p dir="auto">The primary goal of this project, beyond just being a lot of fun to work on, is to provide a
platform with a strong foundation that is meant to be extended. The back-end natively supports
shared global state, transactions, and a simulation engine and should be suitable from everything
from a simple project to play around with to a scalable, multi-player game. A secondary goal is to
make a JS/TS framework available as most simulators in this space (including the original paper
above) are written in Python.</p>

<li><a href="#connect-an-llm">Connect it to an LLM</a></li>
</ol>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Build and Deploy</h2><a id="user-content-build-and-deploy" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Build and Deploy" href="#build-and-deploy"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">There are a few ways to run the app on top of Convex (the backend).</p>
<ol dir="auto">
<li>The standard Convex setup, where you develop locally or in the cloud. This requires a Convex
account(free). This is the easiest way to depoy it to the cloud and seriously develop.</li>
<li>If you want to try it out without an account and you're okay with Docker, the Docker Compose
setup is nice and self-contained.</li>
<li>There's a community fork of this project offering a one-click install on
<a href="https://pinokio.computer/item?uri=https://github.com/cocktailpeanutlabs/aitown" rel="nofollow">Pinokio</a> for
anyone interested in running but not modifying it 😎.</li>
<li>You can also deploy it to <a href="https://fly.io/" rel="nofollow">Fly.io</a>. See <a href="/a16z-infra/ai-town/blob/main/fly">./fly</a> for instructions.</li>
</ol>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Standard Setup</h3><a id="user-content-standard-setup" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Standard Setup" href="#standard-setup"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Note, if you're on Windows, see <a href="#windows-installation">below</a>.</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="git clone https://github.com/a16z-infra/ai-town.git
cd ai-town
npm install"><pre>git clone https://github.com/a16z-infra/ai-town.git
<span class="pl-c1">cd</span> ai-town
npm install</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">This will require logging into your Convex account, if you haven't already.</p>
<p dir="auto">To run it:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="npm run dev"><pre>npm run dev</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">You can now visit <a href="http://localhost:5173" rel="nofollow">http://localhost:5173</a>.</p>
<p dir="auto">If you'd rather run the frontend and backend separately (which syncs your backend functions as
they're saved), you can run these in two terminals:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="npm run dev:frontend
npm run dev:backend"><pre>npm run dev:frontend
npm run dev:backend</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">See <a href="/a16z-infra/ai-town/blob/main/package.json">package.json</a> for details.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Using Docker Compose with self-hosted Convex</h3><a id="user-content-using-docker-compose-with-self-hosted-convex" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Using Docker Compose with self-hosted Convex" href="#using-docker-compose-with-self-hosted-convex"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">You can also run the Convex backend with the self-hosted Docker container. Here we'll set it up to
run the frontend, backend, and dashboard all via docker compose.</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="docker compose up --build -d"><pre>docker compose up --build -d</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">The container will keep running in the background if you pass <code>-d</code>. After you've done it once, you
can <code>stop</code> and <code>start</code> services.</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>The frontend will be running on <a href="http://localhost:5173" rel="nofollow">http://localhost:5173</a>.</li>
<li>The backend will be running on <a href="http://localhost:3210" rel="nofollow">http://localhost:3210</a> (3211 for the http api).</li>
<li>The dashboard will be running on <a href="http://localhost:6791" rel="nofollow">http://localhost:6791</a>.</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">To log into the dashboard and deploy from the convex CLI, you will need to generate an admin key.</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="docker compose exec backend ./generate_admin_key.sh"><pre>docker compose <span class="pl-c1">exec</span> backend ./generate_admin_key.sh</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Add it to your <code>.env.local</code> file. Note: If you run <code>down</code> and <code>up</code>, you'll have to generate the key
again and update the <code>.env.local</code> file.</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="# in .env.local
CONVEX_SELF_HOSTED_ADMIN_KEY="<admin-key>" # Ensure there are quotes around it
CONVEX_SELF_HOSTED_URL="http://127.0.0.1:3210""><pre><span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> in .env.local</span>
CONVEX_SELF_HOSTED_ADMIN_KEY=<span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span><admin-key><span class="pl-pds">"</span></span> <span class="pl-c"><span class="pl-c">#</span> Ensure there are quotes around it</span>
CONVEX_SELF_HOSTED_URL=<span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">"</span>http://127.0.0.1:3210<span class="pl-pds">"</span></span></pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Then set up the Convex backend (one time):</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="npm run predev"><pre>npm run predev</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">To continuously deploy new code to the backend and print logs:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="npm run dev:backend"><pre>npm run dev:backend</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">To see the dashboard, visit <code>http://localhost:6791</code> and provide the admin key you generated earlier.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Configuring Docker for Ollama</h3><a id="user-content-configuring-docker-for-ollama" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Configuring Docker for Ollama" href="#configuring-docker-for-ollama"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">If you'll be using Ollama for local inference, you'll need to configure Docker to connect to it.</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="npx convex env set OLLAMA_HOST http://host.docker.internal:11434"><pre>npx convex env <span class="pl-c1">set</span> OLLAMA_HOST http://host.docker.internal:11434</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">To test the connection (after you <a href="#ollama-default">have it running</a>):</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="docker compose exec backend /bin/bash curl http://host.docker.internal:11434"><pre>docker compose <span class="pl-c1">exec</span> backend /bin/bash curl http://host.docker.internal:11434</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">If it says "Ollama is running", it's good! Otherwise, check out the
<a href="#troubleshooting">Troubleshooting</a> section.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Connect an LLM</h2><a id="user-content-connect-an-llm" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Connect an LLM" href="#connect-an-llm"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Note: If you want to run the backend in the cloud, you can either use a cloud-based LLM API, like
OpenAI or Together.ai or you can proxy the traffic from the cloud to your local Ollama. See
<a href="#using-local-inference-from-a-cloud-deployment">below</a> for instructions.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Ollama (default)</h3><a id="user-content-ollama-default" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Ollama (default)" href="#ollama-default"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">By default, the app tries to use Ollama to run it entirely locally.</p>
<ol dir="auto">
<li>Download and install <a href="https://ollama.com/" rel="nofollow">Ollama</a>.</li>
<li>Open the app or run <code>ollama serve</code> in a terminal. <code>ollama serve</code> will warn you if the app is
already running.</li>
<li>Run <code>ollama pull llama3</code> to have it download <code>llama3</code>.</li>
<li>Test it out with <code>ollama run llama3</code>.</li>
</ol>
<p dir="auto">Ollama model options can be found <a href="https://ollama.ai/library" rel="nofollow">here</a>.</p>
<p dir="auto">If you want to customize which model to use, adjust convex/util/llm.ts or set
<code>npx convex env set OLLAMA_MODEL # model</code>. If you want to edit the embedding model:</p>
<ol dir="auto">
<li>Change the <code>OLLAMA_EMBEDDING_DIMENSION</code> in <code>convex/util/llm.ts</code> and ensure:
<code>export const EMBEDDING_DIMENSION = OLLAMA_EMBEDDING_DIMENSION;</code></li>
<li>Set <code>npx convex env set OLLAMA_EMBEDDING_MODEL # model</code>.</li>
</ol>
<p dir="auto">Note: You might want to set <code>NUM_MEMORIES_TO_SEARCH</code> to <code>1</code> in constants.ts, to reduce the size of
conversation prompts, if you see slowness.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">OpenAI</h3><a id="user-content-openai" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: OpenAI" href="#openai"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">To use OpenAI, you need to:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-ts notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="// In convex/util/llm.ts change the following line:
export const EMBEDDING_DIMENSION = OPENAI_EMBEDDING_DIMENSION;"><pre><span class="pl-c">// In convex/util/llm.ts change the following line:</span>
<span class="pl-k">export</span> <span class="pl-k">const</span> <span class="pl-c1">EMBEDDING_DIMENSION</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-c1">OPENAI_EMBEDDING_DIMENSION</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span></pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Set the <code>OPENAI_API_KEY</code> environment variable. Visit <a href="https://platform.openai.com/account/api-keys" rel="nofollow">https://platform.openai.com/account/api-keys</a> if
you don't have one.</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="npx convex env set OPENAI_API_KEY 'your-key'"><pre>npx convex env <span class="pl-c1">set</span> OPENAI_API_KEY <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">'</span>your-key<span class="pl-pds">'</span></span></pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Optional: choose models with <code>OPENAI_CHAT_MODEL</code> and <code>OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL</code>.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Together.ai</h3><a id="user-content-togetherai" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Together.ai" href="#togetherai"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">To use Together.ai, you need to:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-ts notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="// In convex/util/llm.ts change the following line:
export const EMBEDDING_DIMENSION = TOGETHER_EMBEDDING_DIMENSION;"><pre><span class="pl-c">// In convex/util/llm.ts change the following line:</span>
<span class="pl-k">export</span> <span class="pl-k">const</span> <span class="pl-c1">EMBEDDING_DIMENSION</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-c1">TOGETHER_EMBEDDING_DIMENSION</span><span class="pl-kos">;</span></pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Set the <code>TOGETHER_API_KEY</code> environment variable. Visit <a href="https://api.together.xyz/settings/api-keys" rel="nofollow">https://api.together.xyz/settings/api-keys</a> if
you don't have one.</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-shell notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="npx convex env set TOGETHER_API_KEY 'your-key'"><pre>npx convex env <span class="pl-c1">set</span> TOGETHER_API_KEY <span class="pl-s"><span class="pl-pds">'</span>your-key<span class="pl-pds">'</span></span></pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Optional: choose models via <code>TOGETHER_CHAT_MODEL</code>, <code>TOGETHER_EMBEDDING_MODEL</code>. The embedding model's
dimension must match <code>EMBEDDING_DIMENSION</code>.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Other OpenAI-compatible API</h3><a id="user-content-other-openai-compatible-api" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Other OpenAI-compatible API" href="#other-openai-compatible-api"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.
